scientific_limitations: Three-state deterministic threshold-two synchronous excitation only on labelled complete split graphs; exact six-class reduction and exhaustive certificate plus separate small-instance checks, with residual unindexed-equivalence risk. No independent validation. Dated first preprint evidence is arXiv:patt-sol/9304001v1 (1993-04-02); the foundational journal paper also existed in 1991, but its initial public release day is not established here.
title: Three-phase recurrent-state growth for threshold-two excitable split graphs
